## 1. Cleaning, validation and study scope

Explain string/factor/date operations, missingness, sequential exclusions and validation. State why this is a filtered snapshot rather than a random sample of all Boston lodging.

**The string**

```{r section1}
cleaning_audit
```

## 2. Exploring the budget listings

Discuss shape, mean/median, unusual values, room-type differences and review status. Explain the $500 cutoff and why reviews do not directly measure demand.

**Replace this prompt with your response.**

```{r section2}
 room_summary
 review_summary
 plot_price
 plot_room
 plot_capacity
```

## 3. Guest capacity and listed price

Write the equation and interpret slope, intercept, the four-guest prediction and the first residual. Discuss residual structure and causality.

**Replace this prompt with your response.**

```{r section3}
 capacity_cor
 capacity_terms
 capacity_predictions
 head(capacity_augmented, 1)
 plot_residual
```

## 4. Private rooms versus entire places

Interpret the reference mean and difference. Demonstrate equality to group means and explain why this comparison is unadjusted.

**Replace this prompt with your response.**

```{r section4}

```

## 5. Sampling variability

Compare centers and spreads, individual-price SD and sample-mean SD. Explain the seed, sampling design and limited population.

